fuse_conv_bn: fuse a conv2d and batchnorm2d module into a single fused conv-bn module for quantization
fuse_conv_bn_relu: fuse a conv2d, batchnorm2d, and relu module into a single fused conv-bn-relu module for quantization
fuse_linear_bn: fuse a linear layer and batchnorm1d module into a single fused linear-bn module for quantization
get_fuser_method: get the fuser method from the default op list to fuser method mapping for a given pattern
get_fuser_method_new: get the fuser method from a custom fuser method mapping dictionary for a given op pattern
